physics-h3-q2.material: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?

Xa kungekho kumelana komoya, ngokulandelelana yeyiphi i-engile yokukhuphela θ eyenza umgama ohambayo ube phezulu, kunye nenye i-engile yokukhuphela enomgama ohambayo ofanayo nokhukhulelo lwe-30°?

physics-killer-12.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
physics-killer-12.topic: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
physics-killer-12.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-12.material: Phezu komgangatho othe tye kubekwe iirelsi ezimbini ezifanayo zesikhokelisi ezinomgama $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, kwaye esinye isiphelo siqhagamshelwe kumelana. Ukumelana okupheleleyo kwesekethe evaliweyo eyakhiwe ngerelsi, umthi wesikhokelisi nokumelana $2\,\Omega$. Umbane omagnethi ohambelana othe nkqo $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ usebenza kuyo yonke isekethe, kwaye umthi wesikhokelisi uhamba phezu kwerelsi ngesantya esingatshintshiyo $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kude nokumelana. Ngexesha apho umthi uhamba $2\,\mathrm{m}$ ngexesha $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$, i-magnetic flux ehamba kwisekethe itshintsha nge-$\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubungakanani bomsinga obangelwayo kwisekethe kunye nobungakanani bamandla angaphandle afunekayo ukugcina umthi usesantyeni esingatshintshiyo ngokulandelelana? (Akukho kukhuhlana.)

physics-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: Phezu komgangatho othe tye kubekwe iirelsi ezimbini ezifanayo zesikhokelisi ezinomgama $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, kwaye esinye isiphelo siqhagamshelwe kumelana. Ukumelana okupheleleyo kwesekethe evaliweyo eyakhiwe ngerelsi, umthi wesikhokelisi nokumelana $2\,\Omega$. Umbane omagnethi ohambelana othe nkqo $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ usebenza kuyo yonke isekethe, kwaye umthi wesikhokelisi uhamba phezu kwerelsi ngesantya esingatshintshiyo $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ kude nokumelana. Ngexesha apho umthi uhamba $2\,\mathrm{m}$ ngexesha $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$, i-magnetic flux ehamba kwisekethe itshintsha nge-$\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubungakanani bomsinga obangelwayo kwisekethe kunye nobungakanani bamandla angaphandle afunekayo ukugcina umthi usesantyeni esingatshintshiyo ngokulandelelana? (Akukho kukhuhlana.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.explain: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ (iyahambelana ne-$=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Amandla emagnethi asebenza kumthi ngu-$F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (ngokomthetho ka-Lenz ngecala elithintela intshukumo) kwaye kuba intshukumo ayitshintshi, namandla angaphandle ngu-$0.125\,\mathrm{N}$. Ukuqinisekisa: amandla amandla angaphandle $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Ukuba $\ell$ iyalityalwa, $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (impendulo engalunganga ①), ukuba $\ell$ ilityalwa kumandla, $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (impendulo engalunganga ②), impazamo yokuphinda-phinda $\mathcal E$ ngo-$\frac12$ ngumphendulo ongalunganga ④.
